text: The authors say their approach can be considered a form of recursive reward modeling (Leike et al., 2018), if model-generated lower-level summaries are understood as helping the human evaluate higher-level summaries. They state their contribution is showing that this approach can be realistically applied to a difficult, large-scale task.
